title: STATE.md and the roadmap's V1 section catch up with the playtest rounds; the --story-world Rotor heat peak is sampled per frame inside the page
context: docs/STATE.md still read 'Updated 2026-09-16 (the V1 session, overnight build)' and knew nothing of the playtest rounds that followed the same day (input and views, difficulty and rebuild, the grey sheet, walls not rock, the legacy tank, the Quiver's scope, the foundry beat, the MK-9, SKIP TUTORIAL, the merge regressions, the playthrough fixes, rock breaks with live breaches, the laser lab step). Its priority 2 documented the --story-world Rotor heat-peak step as flaky: the harness banked window.__rotorHeatMax only inside its until() poll bodies (one sample per 150 ms plus a CDP round trip) while state().key was 'rotor', so a run where the piloted Rotor cleared the wave quickly sampled the barrels' cooling curve by luck and read 0.037, 0.040 and 0.041 on three branches against a 0.05 floor while passing on main both times (2026-09-16-legacy-tank-removed, 2026-09-16-playtest-grey-sheet, 2026-09-16-quiver-scope-built). The threshold was not to be lowered.
outcome: docs/STATE.md rewritten short and current: the V1 session with its two entry points (the bare page and index.html?skip=defence#td), what landed on 2026-09-16 in one line each with its entry id, the owner's two open calls (trimming the foundry beat's +14.5 s; ~48 fps at 400+ concurrent enemies, 406 alive at p50 20.9 ms, being profiled), the known gaps (no second gate, Isao's gate repair unanimated, SOL-82 burning only the Stalheart among buildings, the gunship seat's first-use hitch, the MK-9 ignition fireball oversized close up, one release per pass unverified end to end, the laser scorch surviving NEW RUN, Isao not flying to the dropped crate, touch labels untested, the Y-scale print) and an Evidence section naming every browser step in scripts/browser-test.mjs. The hand-written V1 section of ROADMAP.md says the same in its Committed / Candidate / Question shape; the generated Open in the log block is the renderer's. In scripts/browser-test.mjs the heat measurement moved into the page: once the Rotor seat is taken in the stage-4 world, a requestAnimationFrame hook reads window.__stalheartPilotTest.state() every frame, records the max of .heat while .key is 'rotor' and the frame count, and removes itself when the key changes (the Quiver hand-over), the seat is left (the hook object is deleted) or state() throws. The two poll bodies no longer bank anything; the assertion keeps its meaning and its 0.05 floor, additionally requires that the hook sampled at least one frame, and logs the peak and the frame count. Measured per frame the peak is 0.1015, twice the floor, so the earlier failures were the harness's polling, not the barrels.
alternatives: Lower the 0.05 threshold to what the polled samples read: rejected, it would have hidden the sampling error rather than fixing it and weakened a real assertion about the barrels.
Fire a fresh burst at the assertion: rejected on 2026-09-14 already, since by then the seat may be the Quiver's.
Poll faster from the harness: still a CDP round trip per sample, so still luck; per-frame in the page is the barrels' real peak.
Also refresh the stale rows of the roadmap's Now table (td-tab at 17,608, Heavy Gunship designed not built): left alone, the task was the V1 section; the rows are the owner's prose to argue with.
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world on this change: exit 0, 31 PASS from story-world-candidate through story-world-default, story-world-rotor-kill, story-world-harvest and story-world-cleared included; the new log line read 'rotor heat peak 0.1015 over 885 frames in the seat'.

Before, the same step read 0.037, 0.0367, 0.0402 and 0.041 from harness polls on three branches (2026-09-16-legacy-tank-removed, 2026-09-16-playtest-grey-sheet, 2026-09-16-quiver-scope-built) and passed on main twice.

npm test: 120 test programs passed. npm run check: syntax, source module identity, pinned kernel, logs and assets checked; architecture 87 pure-layer modules, line budgets hold. npm run log:check: valid.

The browser steps listed in STATE.md are the flags read by args.includes('--...') in scripts/browser-test.mjs: breach-game, sinkhole, story, gunship, nav, sectors, waves (--last), defense, grow, shield-story, skip-tutorial, backdoor, quiver-frame, story-world, shield-perf, missile-parity, laser-game, laser, debrief, plus --dist.
